name: otel-exporter-target-policy
title: Decide and enforce an OTEL exporter target policy
description: The OTEL exporter endpoint derives from CLI/env (MEZMO_OTEL_*) with no target allowlist, so the sender can be pointed at any host. Likely acceptable for an operator-configured exporter, but there is no conscious guard or documented decision. Decide policy (allowlist/warn/accept) and document it.
creator: sdelmas
